decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album "Something for Everybody." Multiple distinct albums share this title, each attributed to different artists. Document D1S1 attributes the album to Elvis Presley, D4S1 to Devo, and D5S1 to Baz Luhrmann. These are valid referents under the same title, and the original R5_answers include all three. Since the instruction emphasizes preserving distinct valid referents and complementary answers, all three are retained.
